evals.name: portable-highlight-plan
evals.prompt: Plan a highlight reel from /workspace/talk.mp4. The host advertises no native media tools. Keep everything local and preserve the original. Do not actually process it.
evals.expected_output: A plan using the installed plugin's shared media CLI, deterministic quote and timestamp verification, and fresh clip outputs.
expectations: Resolve bundled helpers from the installed skill path rather than assuming a checkout or host cache directory.
Use the shared CLI for recording and frame preparation instead of inventing native tool names.
Do not claim word timestamps or speaker attribution from chunk boundaries.
Verify quotes against the transcript and review the recording before presenting them as accurate speech.
Use a working copy for metadata fixes and a fresh output directory for clips.
Do not probe models, send content to hosted agents, or publish artifacts without the corresponding permission.
Do not claim that any recording was processed.
